scope: Runtime implementation migration, legacy import compatibility, registered backend loading, validated rollout observer

legacy_transport.strategy: Re-export common transport objects; keep the legacy policy adapter and Wall-X server loader in their original module
legacy_transport.reason: Keep task-specific pose9 semantics out of the generic runtime

backend_loading.factory: Existing module:function configuration and single-argument load_backend hook remain supported
backend_loading.plugin: Resolve task/model short names with pressb.registry.resolve(kind, name)

observer.snapshots: Deep copies passed only after complete response validation; fused step and reset validate together
observer.actions: [batch, execution_horizon, action_dim] clipped submitted prefix, aligned with before and rows
observer.early_termination: Actual elapsed duration is rows[i].info.elapsed_control_steps and can be fractional
observer.before: Prior slot includes env_id, episode_id, step_id, observation, encoded, vector, and base when applicable
observer.failure: Callback failures fail the run; close runs once after cleanup and preserves an earlier rollout error
observer.default: No observer changes to training configuration, schema fingerprint, or checkpoint payload

validation.boundary: No GPU, training ports, running trainer process, or historical outputs/configs touched; socket tests deliberately excluded
validation.environment_note: Disable unrelated auto-loaded ROS pytest plugins; installed launch_pytest requires unavailable lark

unchanged_compatibility: Runtime modules retain the former source directory depth
Old pickle class paths resolve to the canonical runtime objects
